changeSet.author: nexus-p2m1x.14
changeSet.comment: Register the data move rdr229-reown-repo-stems-from-curator over nexus.catalog_collections (RDR-246, RDR-229): one INSERT into nexus.data_moves, no policy
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO nexus.data_moves (label, template, driving_schema, driving_table, chunk_size, sleep_ms, statement_timeout_ms, verification, on_complete, changeset_id) VALUES ('rdr229-reown-repo-stems-from-curator', 'WITH lck AS ( SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext(''catalog_owners/'' || current_setting(''nexus.tenant'', true))) AS locked ), stemrows AS ( SELECT c.name, c.content_type, c.embedding_model, c.model_version, c.owner_id, split_part(c.name, ''__'', 2) AS stem FROM nexus.catalog_collections c WHERE c.tenant_id = current_setting(''nexus.tenant'', true) AND c.content_type IN (''code'', ''docs'', ''rdr'') AND c.lifecycle_state = ''live'' AND c.superseded_by = '''' AND split_part(c.name, ''__'', 1) = c.content_type AND split_part(c.name, ''__'', 2) ~ ''^.+-[0-9a-f]{8}$'' ), cand AS ( SELECT DISTINCT r.stem FROM stemrows r WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM nexus.catalog_owners o WHERE o.tenant_id = current_setting(''nexus.tenant'', true) AND o.owner_type = ''repo'' AND o.repo_hash = right(r.stem, 8)) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM stemrows k WHERE k.stem = r.stem AND k.content_type = ''code'' AND nexus.catalog_owner_is_curator(current_setting(''nexus.tenant'', true), k.owner_id)) ), stems AS ( SELECT stem, left(stem, length(stem) - 9) AS slug, right(stem, 8) AS hash8, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY left(stem, length(stem) - 9) ORDER BY stem) AS nth FROM cand ), mx AS ( SELECT COALESCE(max(CASE WHEN split_part(o.tumbler_prefix, ''.'', 2) ~ ''^[0-9]{1,9}$'' THEN split_part(o.tumbler_prefix, ''.'', 2)::int END), 0) AS n FROM nexus.catalog_owners o WHERE o.tenant_id = current_setting(''nexus.tenant'', true) AND o.tumbler_prefix LIKE ''1.%'' ), fresh AS ( SELECT d.stem, d.slug, d.hash8, d.nth, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY d.stem) AS rn FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (s.hash8) s.stem, s.slug, s.hash8, s.nth FROM stems s ORDER BY s.hash8, s.stem) d WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM nexus.catalog_owners r WHERE r.tenant_id = current_setting(''nexus.tenant'', true) AND r.repo_hash = d.hash8) ), ins AS ( INSERT INTO nexus.catalog_owners (tenant_id, tumbler_prefix, name, owner_type, repo_hash, repo_root) SELECT current_setting(''nexus.tenant'', true), ''1.'' || (mx.n + f.rn), CASE WHEN f.nth > 1 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM nexus.catalog_owners r WHERE r.tenant_id = current_setting(''nexus.tenant'', true) AND r.name = f.slug AND r.owner_type = ''repo'') THEN f.stem ELSE f.slug END, ''repo'', f.hash8, '''' FROM lck CROSS JOIN fresh f CROSS JOIN mx ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING RETURNING tumbler_prefix, repo_hash ), repo_owner AS ( SELECT i.tumbler_prefix, i.repo_hash FROM ins i UNION SELECT r.tumbler_prefix, r.repo_hash FROM nexus.catalog_owners r WHERE r.tenant_id = current_setting(''nexus.tenant'', true) AND r.owner_type = ''repo'' AND r.repo_hash IS NOT NULL AND r.repo_hash <> '''' ), occ AS ( SELECT r.name, r.owner_id, r.content_type, w.tumbler_prefix AS dest_prefix, min(h.name) AS held_by FROM stemrows r JOIN stems s ON s.stem = r.stem JOIN repo_owner w ON w.repo_hash = s.hash8 JOIN nexus.catalog_collections h ON h.tenant_id = current_setting(''nexus.tenant'', true) AND h.owner_id = replace(w.tumbler_prefix, ''.'', ''-'') AND h.content_type = r.content_type AND h.embedding_model = r.embedding_model AND h.model_version = r.model_version AND h.lifecycle_state = ''live'' AND h.superseded_by = '''' AND h.name <> r.name WHERE nexus.catalog_owner_is_curator(current_setting(''nexus.tenant'', true), r.owner_id) GROUP BY r.name, r.owner_id, r.content_type, w.tumbler_prefix ), ranked AS ( SELECT m.name, m.owner_id, m.content_type, m.dest_prefix, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY m.dest_prefix, m.content_type, m.embedding_model, m.model_version ORDER BY m.name) AS rn, first_value(m.name) OVER (PARTITION BY m.dest_prefix, m.content_type, m.embedding_model, m.model_version ORDER BY m.name) AS first_name FROM (SELECT r.name, r.owner_id, r.content_type, r.embedding_model, r.model_version, w.tumbler_prefix AS dest_prefix FROM stemrows r JOIN stems s ON s.stem = r.stem JOIN repo_owner w ON w.repo_hash = s.hash8 WHERE nexus.catalog_owner_is_curator(current_setting(''nexus.tenant'', true), r.owner_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM occ o WHERE o.name = r.name)) m ), skipped AS ( SELECT o.name, o.owner_id, o.content_type, o.dest_prefix, o.held_by, ''destination tuple held by '' || o.held_by AS reason FROM occ o UNION ALL SELECT k.name, k.owner_id, k.content_type, k.dest_prefix, k.first_name, ''destination tuple claimed in this run by '' || k.first_name FROM ranked k WHERE k.rn > 1 ), reported AS ( INSERT INTO nexus.gc_audit (tenant_id, operation, collection, actor, dry_run, chash_count, chashes, details) SELECT current_setting(''nexus.tenant'', true), ''rdr229_reown_skipped'', k.name, ''data-move:rdr229-reown-repo-stems-from-curator'', false, 0, ''[]''::jsonb, jsonb_build_object(''reason'', k.reason, ''owner_id'', k.owner_id, ''destination_owner_id'', replace(k.dest_prefix, ''.'', ''-''), ''content_type'', k.content_type, ''held_by'', k.held_by) FROM skipped k WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM nexus.gc_audit g WHERE g.tenant_id = current_setting(''nexus.tenant'', true) AND g.operation = ''rdr229_reown_skipped'' AND g.collection = k.name) RETURNING id ) UPDATE <driving_table> SET owner_id = replace(w.tumbler_prefix, ''.'', ''-'') FROM stems s JOIN repo_owner w ON w.repo_hash = s.hash8 WHERE <chunking_clause> AND t.tenant_id = current_setting(''nexus.tenant'', true) AND nexus.catalog_owner_is_curator(t.tenant_id, t.owner_id) AND t.owner_id IS DISTINCT FROM replace(w.tumbler_prefix, ''.'', ''-'') AND ((t.content_type IN (''code'', ''docs'', ''rdr'') AND t.lifecycle_state = ''live'' AND t.superseded_by = '''' AND split_part(t.name, ''__'', 1) = t.content_type AND split_part(t.name, ''__'', 2) = s.stem AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM skipped k WHERE k.name = t.name)) OR (t.lifecycle_state = ''quarantine'' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM stemrows o WHERE o.stem = s.stem AND t.name = ''quarantine-'' || o.name) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM skipped k WHERE t.name = ''quarantine-'' || k.name)))', 'nexus', 'catalog_collections', 1000, 0, 60000, 'SELECT 1 FROM nexus.catalog_collections t WHERE t.content_type IN (''code'', ''docs'', ''rdr'') AND t.lifecycle_state = ''live'' AND t.superseded_by = '''' AND split_part(t.name, ''__'', 1) = t.content_type AND split_part(t.name, ''__'', 2) ~ ''^.+-[0-9a-f]{8}$'' AND nexus.catalog_owner_is_curator(t.tenant_id, t.owner_id) AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM nexus.catalog_owners r WHERE r.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND r.owner_type = ''repo'' AND r.repo_hash = right(split_part(t.name, ''__'', 2), 8)) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM nexus.catalog_collections k WHERE k.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND k.content_type = ''code'' AND k.lifecycle_state = ''live'' AND k.superseded_by = '''' AND split_part(k.name, ''__'', 1) = ''code'' AND split_part(k.name, ''__'', 2) = split_part(t.name, ''__'', 2) AND nexus.catalog_owner_is_curator(k.tenant_id, k.owner_id))) AND NOT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM nexus.catalog_owners w JOIN nexus.catalog_collections h ON h.tenant_id = w.tenant_id AND h.owner_id = replace(w.tumbler_prefix, ''.'', ''-'') AND h.content_type = t.content_type AND h.embedding_model = t.embedding_model AND h.model_version = t.model_version AND h.lifecycle_state = ''live'' AND h.superseded_by = '''' AND h.name <> t.name WHERE w.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND w.owner_type = ''repo'' AND w.repo_hash = right(split_part(t.name, ''__'', 2), 8)) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM nexus.gc_audit g WHERE g.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND g.operation = ''rdr229_reown_skipped'' AND g.collection = t.name)) AND (t.tenant_id = $1 OR $1 IS NULL)', NULL, 'vectors-067-1');
